title: Human Capital Planning
overview: Human capital professionals need to align their activities with the company’s strategic objectives, positioning HR as a true business partner. A well-structured Human Capital (HC) Plan bridges this gap by connecting HR initiatives to the broader business strategy. This course equips participants with the skills to develop and implement an HC plan that secures HR's role at the decision-making table, demonstrating its strategic value to the organization
audience: This course is designed for HR and human capital managers, business partners, team leaders, and specialists involved in human capital planning.
methodology: The course uses a practical approach that combines in-depth explanation of HC plan components with hands-on exercises. Participants will work on creating a real HC plan by the end of the course, which will be assessed and evaluated through individual and team activities, as well as case studies.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Gain a comprehensive understanding of the Human Capital Plan
Develop an HC plan that aligns with the organization’s business strategy
Monitor and review the progress of HR initiatives
Evaluate and refine the HC plan to ensure effectiveness
Demonstrate how a well-crafted HC plan enhances human capital management value

outline.title: From Business Objectives to HR Objectives
